gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-noto-sans-glago: Noto Sans Glagolitic offers round, open letters with a tall, sturdy lowercase body that stays legible when small. Noto Sans Glagolitic feels grounded beside Delius Unicase, whose fixed-pressure stylus line adds a relaxed, hand-drawn warmth above it.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-noto-sans-gothi: Chunky, hand-drawn heading, glassy open body. If Delius Unicase were shrunk down, its single-thickness strokes would crowd, while Noto Sans Gothic, a plain sans with parenthesis-round forms, holds up at any size.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-noto-sans-grant: Noto Sans Grantha reads smoothly, with tall little letters and bowls that never close up and snag. Noto Sans Grantha against the monoline, handwritten Delius Unicase makes the strongest quality of the pair a sturdy sans grounding a cheerful, relaxed hand.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-noto-sans-gujar: Noto Sans Gujarati ends its curves before they turn inward, leaving large open counters in tall a, e and s. And Delius Unicase, with stroke widths that never shift, adds a casual handwritten looseness the sans lets breathe.
